title: How to Set Up Menus for Your Courses and Lessons

steps.raw_text: In your WordPress dashboard, go to **Appearance** > **Menus**.
Click the **create a new menu** link near the top of the page.
steps.context: link near the top of the page

steps.raw_text: Enter a descriptive name for your menu (e.g., "Course Navigation" or "Student Menu").
On the left side of the **Menus** screen, locate the **Pages**, **Custom Links**, or **Categories** panels.
steps.context: screen, locate the Pages, Custom Links, or Categories panels

steps.raw_text: To add your main courses page, check the box next to it under **Pages** and click **Add to Menu**.
To add individual course or lesson links, use the **Custom Links** panel—enter the URL and link text, then click **Add to Menu**.
steps.context: panel—enter the URL and link text, then click Add to Menu

steps.raw_text: Drag and drop menu items to reorder them or create dropdown sub-menus by nesting items.

sections.heading: Assigning the Menu to Your Course Pages

steps.raw_text: Scroll down to the **Menu Settings** section at the bottom of the **Menus** page.
steps.context: section at the bottom of the Menus page

steps.raw_text: Under **Display location**, check the box that corresponds to the menu position you want (this depends on your theme—common options include **Primary Menu**, **Header Menu**, or **Secondary Menu**).
